defs.def: a small individual fact or item; a less important fact or item 细微之处；枝节；琐事

ex.s: When it came to faking a review, length was important to believability, as was detail.
ex.t: 在伪造评论时，长度对可信度很重要，细节也很重要。

ex.s: Beautiful year-round, they invite you to enjoy the smallest detail, from the sound of grasses in the gentle wind to the sculpture of odd-looking seed heads.
ex.t: 它们四季皆美，邀请你欣赏最细微之处，从微风中草叶的声音到奇形怪状的种荚雕塑。

ex.s: To collect details for writing novels.
ex.t: 为写小说收集细节。

ex.s: The goal of this book is to make the case for digital minimalism, including a detailed exploration of what it asks and why it works, and then to teach you how to adopt this philosophy if you decide it’s right for you.
ex.t: 这本书的目标是论证数字极简主义，包括对其要求和原理的详尽探索，然后教你如果认为适合就如何采纳这种哲学。

ex.s: We _________bother with details, for our teammates will do everything in their power to help us.
ex.t: 我们不必在意细节，因为队友会尽全力帮助我们。

ex.s: We respond to stories, particularly when there is emotional detail.
ex.t: 我们对故事有反应，尤其是当有情感细节时。

ex.s: Emotional and physical details.
ex.t: 情感和身体的细节。

ex.s: You don't have to write these things in detail.
ex.t: 你不必详细地写这些东西。

ex.s: We can't appreciate these kinds of details without seeing works of art as they originally appeared-something Smith believes you can do only when you have a road map.
ex.t: 如果不把艺术作品当作它们最初呈现的样子来欣赏，我们就无法欣赏这类细节——Smith 认为只有当你有一张路线图时才能做到。

ex.s: The idea is that white coats are associated with scientists, who are in turn though to have close attention to detail.
ex.t: 这个想法是，白大褂与科学家有关，而科学家又被认为对细节密切关注。

ex.s: This kind of planned revisit could also be for confirming certain details in the text, or for checking on the moves of a given character.
ex.t: 这种有计划的重读也可以用于确认文中的某些细节，或检查某个特定角色的动作。

ex.s: Features are written in an individual style, with extra detail and background.
ex.t: 特写以独特的风格写成，带有额外的细节和背景。

ex.s: This means that great books can lose plot details and characters when they move to the big screen.
ex.t: 这意味着伟大的书籍在搬上大银幕时可能会丢失情节细节和人物。

ex.s: Small in size but full of information, a travel brochure can be a great way to find out all about another country, including its culture, people, geography and many other details.
ex.t: 旅行手册体积小但信息丰富，是了解另一个国家的好方法，包括其文化、人民、地理和许多其他细节。

ex.s: The detail about the string and the key is true.
ex.t: 关于绳子和钥匙的细节是真实的。

defs.def: the small facts or features of sth, when you consider them all together 详情；全部细节

ex.s: Impressed with its detailed instructions.
ex.t: 对其详细的说明印象深刻。

ex.s: By giving details of its collection.
ex.t: 通过提供其藏品的详情。

ex.s: D．Explain the details with illustrations．
ex.t: D．用插图解释细节。

ex.s: Consider turning your travel plan over to a travel agent and letting him double-check all the details, make suggestions, and then handle the actual reservations.
ex.t: 考虑把你的旅行计划交给旅行代理，让他复核所有细节、提出建议，然后处理实际的预订。

ex.s: In part one, I describe the philosophical foundations of digital minimalism, starting with an examination of the forces that are making so many people’s digital lives increasingly intolerable, before moving on to a detailed discussion of the digital minimalism philosophy.
ex.t: 在第一部分，我描述了数字极简主义的哲学基础，首先考察了使如此多人的数字生活日益难以忍受的力量，然后详细讨论了数字极简主义哲学。

ex.s: His works are known throughout the world, though few details are known about his life.
ex.t: 他的作品闻名世界，尽管关于他生平的细节鲜为人知。

defs.def: information about sth 具体情况；（关于某事物的）资料，消息

ex.s: If your student ID card no longer works or has been damaged, or if you have changed your personal or programme details, you should call into the Student Administration Centre （SAC） to request a new one.
ex.t: 如果你的学生证不再有效或已损坏，或者你更改了个人或项目资料，你应该到学生管理中心的柜台申请一张新的。

ex.s: For more details, please visit us online at www.oursac.com.
ex.t: 了解更多详情，请访问我们的网站 www.oursac.com。

ex.s: Then came more than 50027   for detailed information.
ex.t: 随后收到了超过50027份关于详细信息的请求。

defs.def: a small part of a picture or painting; the smaller or less important parts of a picture, pattern, etc. when you consider them all together （照片、绘画等的）细部，局部，次要部分
a group of soldiers given special duties 特遣队；小分队；支队
to give a list of facts or all the available information about sth 详细列举；详细说明；详述

ex.s: The illustration details what followed. — Leslie Nemo
ex.t: 插图详述了后续发生的事情。—— Leslie Nemo

defs.def: to give an official order to sb, especially a soldier, to do a particular task 派遣；选派；分遣
to clean a car extremely thoroughly 彻底清洗（汽车）
